_about: Who runs Rxcurve and how to reach them, and the email sign-up. Maintained by hand; holds no data figures.
build_site.py shows the About page's 'Who runs Rxcurve' section once owner_name, owner_bio and
contact_email are all filled in, and turns the sign-up form on once buttondown_username is filled in
(your Buttondown username, the part after buttondown.com/). Until then the build prints a NOTE.
owner_bio is plain text, one or two sentences: who you are and why you built the site.
